# Andromeda

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-andromeda)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-andromeda)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-andromeda)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-andromeda)

Andromeda is a **dark** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-andromeda codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `andromeda` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { andromeda } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-andromeda';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, andromeda],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `andromeda` | `Extension` |
| `andromedaMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#1b1e26` |
| Active line | `#20242c` |
| Selection | `#512949` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.52:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#d679fa` | bold | 6.33:1 | 5.91:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#d679fa` | bold | 6.33:1 | 5.91:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#c7c7ff` | - | 10.35:1 | 9.66:1 | 7.40:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#c7c7ff` | - | 10.35:1 | 9.66:1 | 7.40:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#24e3c3` | - | 10.20:1 | 9.52:1 | 7.29:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#24e3c3` | - | 10.20:1 | 9.52:1 | 7.29:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#ffdd80` | - | 12.62:1 | 11.78:1 | 9.02:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#24e3c3` | - | 10.20:1 | 9.52:1 | 7.29:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#ffdd80` | - | 12.62:1 | 11.78:1 | 9.02:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#ffdd80` | italic | 12.62:1 | 11.78:1 | 9.02:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#6ae4b9` | italic | 10.64:1 | 9.93:1 | 7.61:1 |
| String | `string` | `#a6e07a` | - | 10.76:1 | 10.05:1 | 7.69:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#a6e07a` | - | 10.76:1 | 10.05:1 | 7.69:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#fc7860` | - | 6.34:1 | 5.92:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Boolean | `bool` | `#fc7860` | - | 6.34:1 | 5.92:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#24e3c3` | - | 10.20:1 | 9.52:1 | 7.29:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#a8aab9` | italic | 7.23:1 | 6.75:1 | 5.17:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#e4dff0` | background, active line, selection | 9.14:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#828fa8` | gutter | 4.53:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#ffffff` | background, active line | 15.55:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#d679fa` | background | 6.33:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #d679fa99` | background, active line | 3.01:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#db45a280, 1px solid #d679fa99` | background (fill or outline) | 3.13:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#db45a248` | active line | 1.31:1 | Pass |
